messages.author: b54b7f0bcb081ed1
messages.subject: rApache with sqldf()
parts:
New to Linux and rApache and trying to move over some of our scripts
to web apps. Having great success with rApache (thanks!) except for
when I try to run a script that uses the sqldf library. In firefox I
just get a blank page and in IE I get "Internet Explorer cannot
display this page". I can't find where any errors are logged and the
scripts seem to run perfect in R itself through terminal. Is there
something weird about using sqldf() inside rApache?

Thanks,
Brad

messages.author: 42eed4e1caba0ad0
messages.subject: Re: rApache with sqldf()
parts: What about the other browsers? Could you try running that in Firefox (with Firebug) and see what happens on the Net panel (response headers should be informative).

Thanks,
Brad

When you say you can find where errors are logged, are you indicating
that you know where the log files are and your app is not printing
any? Otherwise, I'll presume you're running ubuntu and say that the
logs will be in /var/log/apache2...

Jeff

messages.author: 48f24841e806e6c6
messages.subject: Re: rApache with sqldf()
parts:
Your log indicates that apache/rApache is loading the wrong sqlite3 R or c libray? Given that you can run the script on the command line and it works.

Jeff

On May 31, 2011 12:58 PM, "Brad Baker" <bjb...@gmail.com> wrote:
> New to Linux and rApache and trying to move over some of our scripts
> to web apps. Having great success with rApache (thanks!) except for
> when I try to run a script that uses the sqldf library. In firefox I
> just get a blank page and in IE I get "Internet Explorer cannot
> display this page". I can't find where any errors are logged and the
> scripts seem to run perfect in R itself through terminal. Is there
> something weird about using sqldf() inside rApache?
>
> Thanks,
> Brad
